rationale: Both the final message and contribution.md identify the prior work as white-bear steering (the message says "white-bear steering" and "WBS", the contribution.md cites "white-bear steering (Raman et al., 2026)"), and both report the same overlap finding (cosine 0.95 with the directed_modulation stance direction) and the same novelty argument (self-authored contrast pairs, independent carriers/concepts, fit-optimized dose rather than the prior-work dose).
